name: Spectrum TV (Charter Communications)
notes: Researched from public spectrum.net support articles only (no sign-in). Spectrum.net accounts sign in with a Spectrum username (created with Create a Username after verifying by phone, email or account number and security code); the Primary user (or an Admin) makes payments and manages Auto Pay. One-time payments: Billing > Make a Payment, choose amount, date and method, then Make Payment. Auto Pay: Billing > Enroll in Auto Pay (card, debit card, checking or savings; non-reloadable prepaid cards not allowed); cancel with Billing > Manage Auto Pay > Cancel Auto Pay at least three business days before the draft. A $5 fee applies to failed Auto Pay payments (since May 14, 2025) and a $5 processing fee applies to phone payments taken by an agent; the automated phone line is free. Paperless Billing is a toggle under More > Settings > Notifications. Cancelling TV service is not offered as a self-service flow on the public pages: the cancel article says to sign in to view cancellation options and the Contact Us page sends TV, Internet and Home Phone questions to (833) 267-6094 or a Spectrum Store, so cancel_service is unsupported online (inferred) with that number. Reviewer 2026-10-09: an earlier cancel number that appears on no official Spectrum page was replaced. No guest payment without signing in is documented online (the automated phone line is the no-sign-in route), so guest_pay is unsupported (inferred). Payment extensions are not documented on public pages; payment_arrangement keeps the family default. TV package prices vary by ZIP and are not published on the support pages, so plans are left out. Late fees vary by state and are left out. The two-step sign-in comes from the family template (not verified).

guest_pay.note: Online payments need a Spectrum username. Without signing in, pay through the free automated phone line, your bank's bill pay, a Spectrum Store or by mail.

autopay_cancel.note: Cancel Auto Pay at least three business days before the scheduled payment, or that payment is still drafted.

cancel_service.note: Spectrum does not publish self-service cancel steps for TV. Call Spectrum at 833-267-6094 or visit a Spectrum Store to cancel TV service.

help.title: How to pay your bill
paragraphs: You can pay your Spectrum bill online at Spectrum.net or in the My Spectrum App with a checking or savings account, a debit card or a credit card. Sign in as the Primary or Admin user, open Billing, choose Make a Payment, set the payment amount, date and method, then select Make Payment. A notice in the Billing section shows the amount and status of any payment you make or schedule.

To pay by phone, call 833-267-6094 and use the automated system; paying with the help of a customer service agent adds a $5.00 processing fee. Paying through your bank's online bill pay is free, and Spectrum Stores accept cash, checks and cards with no processing fee. Some Western Union, MoneyGram, Walmart and Schnucks locations also take payments under their own rules.
To pay by mail, send the payment slip from your bill with a check or money order showing your account number, to the address printed on your statement. Do not mail cash.
steps: Sign in as the Primary or Admin user.
Adjust the Payment Amount, Payment Date and Payment Method.

help.title: How to set up Auto Pay
paragraphs: Pay any existing balance with a one-time payment before you enroll, so you do not get a late fee. Then sign in as the Primary user, open the Billing tab, select Enroll in Auto Pay, enter your payment details and follow the prompts.
Auto Pay accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express credit cards, debit cards, and checking or savings accounts. Non-reloadable prepaid cards cannot be used.

Auto Pay follows your billing cycle: if you enroll after your billing date, the first automatic payment happens in the next cycle. You can pick a different withdrawal date under Manage Auto Pay, Auto Pay Date.
steps: Sign in as the Primary user.
Enter your payment method details and complete enrollment.

help.title: Cancel Auto Pay or change its payment method
paragraphs: To stop Auto Pay, sign in as the Primary or Admin user, choose Billing, then Manage Auto Pay, select Cancel Auto Pay and confirm. Do this at least three business days before your scheduled payment, otherwise that payment is still charged. After cancelling you receive paper bills unless you turn on Paperless Billing.
To switch the account or card used, open Manage Auto Pay, choose Change Payment Method, fill in the new details and select Review and Complete. Changes take effect by the next billing cycle.
steps: Sign in as the Primary or Admin user.
Select Billing, then Manage Auto Pay.
Select Cancel Auto Pay again to confirm.

help.title: Auto Pay failure fee
paragraphs: Since May 14, 2025 Spectrum charges a $5 fee when an Auto Pay payment fails. Spectrum notifies you right away and gives you three days to add a valid electronic payment method before the fee is applied.

Your bill can also change when a promotional rate ends, when installation or activation charges apply, when local taxes change, or when you buy On Demand or Pay-Per-View programming. Spectrum adds a reminder to your bill the month before a promotion ends.

help.title: Paperless Billing
paragraphs: Sign in, select More and then Settings, open the Notifications tab and, under Billing & Order Notifications, switch the Paperless Billing toggle. Once enrolled you get your bill by email each month and can change the preference at any time.

help.title: Change or cancel your Spectrum service
paragraphs: You can upgrade TV, Internet or Home Phone online: sign in as the primary user, choose Upgrade, pick the service and option, review it and select Purchase. You can also tune to channel 2495.

Spectrum's support pages do not offer a self-service cancel button; signed-in customers see their cancellation options, and for TV, Internet and Home Phone questions the Contact Us page lists 833-267-6094, or you can visit a Spectrum Store. Equipment can be returned at a Spectrum Store or by mail.
Part-time residents can place TV, Internet or Home Phone on Seasonal status for a low monthly fee instead of cancelling; contact Spectrum to check eligibility.

help.title: Username and password help
paragraphs: Create a username at Spectrum.net or in the My Spectrum App with Create a Username: verify the account with your phone number, email or account number, then set a password and confirm your contact email. The first username is the Primary user, who can add up to four more users. Usernames cannot be changed later.

Forgot your username or password? Select Sign In, then Forgot Username or Password?, confirm the account with your username and ZIP code, phone number, email or account info, and enter the verification code sent by text, email or phone call. Use a strong password that mixes upper- and lowercase letters, numbers and special characters.

extra.intent: Using the Spectrum website's support pages, find out how much Spectrum charges when an Auto Pay payment fails. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Spectrum charges a $5 fee when an Auto Pay payment fails.

extra.intent: You want to cancel your Spectrum TV service. Find out how to do it on the Spectrum site and report the phone number to call. Do not change anything else on the account.
